defects.what: Light cone ends in a conspicuous flat vertical cutoff instead of dissipating.
GIF wave strokes are disproportionately thin compared with the video artwork.

FJPE.craft_notes: Clear centred lockup, readable type and coherent lighthouse. All supplied round-1 views inspected and video decoded with ffmpeg; formats, durations, loop and sub-5MB GIF verified. Motion assessed through timestamped frames and decoded frame measurements.
FJPE.revision_notes: 8-second outputs, exact new tagline, slower sweep consistent with doubled period, and completed text by 5 seconds for a 3-second hold. Composition retained. The 8-second/3-second-hold combination necessarily extends the pre-hold sequence to 5 seconds.

fidelity_misses: At beam onset the beam floats above the rising lighthouse instead of emanating from its lamp.

defects.what: Beam origin is visibly detached above the lighthouse during its rise.
Flat tower base floats above the wave trough.
Large unused upper area leaves the main lockup sitting low and right-heavy.

XVMB.craft_notes: Attractive layered waves and warm typography, but the lighthouse/beam integration needs repair. All supplied round-1 views inspected and video decoded with ffmpeg; formats, duration, loop and GIF size verified. Motion assessed from timestamped frames and frame measurements.
XVMB.revision_notes: Correct 8-second duration, new tagline, half-speed sweep and text completed at 5 seconds, leaving the requested 3-second final hold; visual system retained. Existing beam/base defects persist but were not revision requests.

pairwise_round1.why: FJPE's centred composition and attached light beam are more publication-ready than XVMB's floating tower and detached beam.
